content: A similar experiment using 80 Latvian sentences yielded 17 fully corrected sentences, 15, 22 and 26 respectively for the other categories. As the Latvian model is weaker in general, this also leads to more chances of losing some of the meaning; we exclude it from the more detailed analysis and focus on English and Estonian.
